data.body_html:
Watching the New Year's Eve fireworks from the sea is the ultimate way to welcome 2042. Forget the packed promenades of Puerto Banús – on a private yacht, you get an unobstructed view of the midnight display, with cava in hand and the Mediterranean glittering below. Our fleet of luxury boats departs straight from Puerto Banús marina, putting you minutes from the best anchoring spot. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No hidden costs, just a front-row seat to the biggest party of the year.

Why Choose a Yacht for NYE Fireworks?

Marbella’s fireworks are launched from the beach near the Puerto Banús lighthouse. On land, you’ll be shoulder-to-shoulder with thousands. On the water, you have a private 360° view. The sound echoes off La Concha mountain, and the reflections stretch across the bay. Plus, you avoid the 2-hour traffic jam that clogs the Golden Mile after midnight. Your skipper will have you back at the dock by 00:45 – you’ll be home before the crowds even leave.

Our Fleet for NYE 2041

We have yachts for every group size. All depart from Puerto Banús and include the same all-inclusive package. Here’s a quick overview:

For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the 8-hour rate of €2,299 gives you time for a sunset cruise along the coast, a stop at Cabopino for dinner, and then back for the fireworks. Tier B Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski – ride out to the launch zone for a closer view.

What’s Included in Your NYE Charter

  • Skipper – experienced, English-speaking, local knowledge
  • Fuel – no extra charges
  • Drinks – water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Snacks – light bites (crisps, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance & safety equipment – full legal compliance
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – all taxes included

You are welcome to bring your own food, cake, or decorations. The skipper can also recommend a catering service if you want a full dinner on board.

Best Viewing Spot for the Fireworks

Our skippers will anchor just outside the harbour entrance, about 200 metres from the launch barge. You’ll see the shells explode directly overhead. The yachts are spaced out, so you won’t be crowded. For the best photos, bring a tripod – the long exposure of the reflections on the water is stunning. If you book the Mangusta 80, you can use the jet ski to get even closer (with the skipper’s guidance).

How to Book Your NYE Yacht

Slots fill fast – by mid-November, most yachts are reserved. Contact us via WhatsApp with your group size and preferred boat. We’ll send you availability and a personalised quote. A 50% deposit secures the booking. Balance due 7 days before departure. We accept bank transfer, card, or PayPal. For last-minute bookings (December 20–31), we can sometimes accommodate, but prices may be higher.

Alternative NYE Experiences

If you want to combine the fireworks with a longer trip, consider an 8-hour charter that includes a visit to Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch, then back to Marbella for the evening. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) is ideal for this – its flybridge gives you panoramic views. Or take the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax) for a stable, spacious ride – perfect if anyone in your group gets seasick.

What Our Guests Say (Real Feedback)

We don’t use fake testimonials. But here’s what real guests have told us after NYE charters: “The skipper found the perfect spot – we saw everything without the crowds.” “Having drinks on the deck while the fireworks went off was magical.” “We booked the Mangusta 80 and the jet ski was a bonus.” You can read more on our homepage.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time should we depart for the fireworks?

We recommend departing at least 30 minutes before midnight, around 23:30. This gives you time to cruise to the best viewing spot just off the coast of Puerto Banús and settle in with drinks. Most charters are 2–4 hours, so you can also enjoy a pre-cruise along the Golden Mile.

Which yachts are available for NYE 2041?

Our full fleet is available, from the Dubhe (5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (12 pax). The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski. For groups up to 11, the Azimut 39 is popular. Book early – NYE slots sell out by early December.

Are food and drinks included?

Yes, every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring your own food or a cake. For larger groups, we can arrange catering on request.

Can we bring our own decorations or music?

Absolutely. You can bring banners, balloons, or a Bluetooth speaker. Our yachts have onboard sound systems – just connect your phone. Please no confetti cannons that leave debris in the sea.

What happens if the weather is bad?

If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. December evenings can be cool (12-15°C), so bring a jacket. The yachts have enclosed cabins with heating.

How do I book and pay?

Contact us on WhatsApp for availability and pricing. A 50% deposit secures your slot, with the balance due 7 days before departure. We accept bank transfer, card, or PayPal.

Is there a minimum age or dress code?

No dress code – smart casual is fine. Children are welcome on all yachts. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. The skipper will brief everyone on safety before departure.

Can we see the fireworks from anywhere in the bay?

The best view is from the sea directly opposite the Puerto Banús harbour entrance. Our skippers know the exact coordinates. You will see the full show without crowds – and the reflection on the water is spectacular.
